en: Color postcard showing the seaside promenade in Constanța with the Art Nouveau Constanța Casino on a pier by the Black Sea, a park lawn and a reclining stone statue in the foreground. Reverse side is a Romanian postcard layout with a 40 bani 'ROMANIA – POSTA ROMANA' stamp, postmarks from Mamaia and București dated 1967, handwritten message and address. Printed caption at bottom reads "CONSTANTA — Cazinoul".
